shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright slab with rounded top
horizontal band dividing the surface into registers
row of repeated small signs/marks in a band
figures with raised or extended arms
justification: Both are upright rounded-topped slabs carved in shallow relief with an upper figural field separated by a horizontal line from a band of repeated small signs, and both include profile figures with raised arms. But A depicts animals (quadrupeds, a large bird, snake-like forms, a row of crouching creatures along the top) in an unframed vertical stack, while B depicts a purely human scene of two seated/standing persons facing each other across an offering table with a script line below; the specific subjects, proportions and conventions have nothing distinctive in common.
